title: Testes makeReviewDispatch leem o project.toml vivo: backend codex fica un-CI-testavel e un-shippable como config commitado
description: A suite makeReviewDispatch (test/supervisor/review.test.ts) resolve o reviewer backend a partir do project.toml VIVO ([backend].reviewer). Consequencia descoberta no ciclo CAM-399: commitar [backend].reviewer=codex em qualquer arvore que chega no CI faz ~42 testes makeReviewDispatch falharem fail-closed com 'codex-auth-failed', porque o runner do CI nao tem codex autenticado. Ou seja: (a) codex nao pode virar o reviewer default commitado, e (b) o backend reviewer codex nao pode ser validado no CI de jeito nenhum; a validacao so e possivel via run local do sidecar (como foi feito pra fechar CAM-54). Opcoes de fix: (i) isolar os testes do config vivo (injetar backend fixture via DI), (ii) mockar/stubar o auth preflight do codex nesses testes, e/ou (iii) prover codex auth no CI. Relacionado: CAM-54 (codex backend, fechado por validacao local), CAM-398 (resolucao dinamica de modelo). Ate consertar: manter reviewer=claude no config commitado e validar codex so local. TIPO fix.

spec.scope: Isolate the makeReviewDispatch reviewer-backend resolution from the live on-disk project.toml so the reviewer backend can be injected per-call in tests. Add a test-facing injection seam to MakeReviewDispatchOptions (a pre-resolved reviewBackend/reviewModel override, or a projectConfigPath threaded into readPhaseBackend/readPhaseModel at src/supervisor/review.ts:354-355), thread it through the single production consumer (src/commands/sidecar.ts:1529) with production behavior unchanged (still resolves live), and update the ~41 generic makeDispatchOpts-based tests in test/supervisor/review.test.ts to supply the seam so they no longer read the repo's live scripts/cam/project.toml. Add a regression test proving that a config resolving reviewer=codex no longer breaks the generic dispatch tests with codex-auth-failed. Out of scope: provisioning codex auth in CI, dynamic model resolution (CAM-398), and switching the committed reviewer default to codex.
acceptanceCriteria: MakeReviewDispatchOptions gains a documented test-facing seam to override reviewer-backend/model (or config path) resolution; when the seam is set makeReviewDispatch uses it instead of reading the live project.toml, and when unset it resolves from the live project.toml exactly as before. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

The ~41 generic makeDispatchOpts-based tests in test/supervisor/review.test.ts supply the injection seam and no longer depend on the repo's live scripts/cam/project.toml [backend].reviewer value. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]

A regression test asserts that when the resolved config would select reviewer=codex, the generic dispatch path using the injected seam does not fail with codex-auth-failed. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
The full review test suite passes. [oracle: bun test test/supervisor/review.test.ts]

Production wiring in src/commands/sidecar.ts leaves runtime behavior unchanged: makeReviewDispatch still resolves the reviewer backend from the live scripts/cam/project.toml in production with the seam unset. [oracle: reviewer-judgment]
The full quality spine passes. [oracle: bun run check:all]
gotchas: readPhaseBackend/readPhaseModel (src/config/models.ts:265,158) ALREADY accept an optional configPath param documented for tests; no loader change is needed. The fix threads a seam through makeReviewDispatch (review.ts:354-355), not through models.ts.

src/supervisor/review.ts is imported by exactly ONE production consumer, src/commands/sidecar.ts (line 29 import, line 1529 wiring); src/supervisor/loop.ts does NOT import it. Update the sidecar wiring for any signature change. A coherence rebuild is required after ship because review.ts and sidecar.ts are sidecar-executed.

Mocking the auth preflight (codexAuthCheckFn returning authenticated:true) is a FALSE fix: the backend still resolves to codex and routes through CodexAdapter.buildSpawnArgv which reads .claude/agents/subagent-reviewer.md and re-breaks. The seam must override backend RESOLUTION, not just the auth check.

The 10 existing codex/container tests use withReviewerBackendCwd (review.test.ts:347-370, a real temp project.toml + chdir) and MUST keep passing; do not remove that pattern, it is still needed for argv-shape tests that require a real agent file on disk.
codexAuthCheckFn (review.ts:280) already exists as a call-injectable seam but is insufficient alone: it cannot change reviewBackend.
Do not commit [backend].reviewer=codex into project.toml; keep the current committed reviewer value. This issue makes codex CI-testable, it does not switch the default.
domainTerms: makeReviewDispatch: factory in src/supervisor/review.ts:314 returning the reviewDispatch(uuid) closure that spawns the reviewer worker pane and runs the codex auth preflight.
readPhaseBackend/readPhaseModel: src/config/models.ts resolvers that read [backend].<phase> and [models] from project.toml; both accept an optional configPath test override.
withReviewerBackendCwd: test helper (review.test.ts:347) that writes a temp project.toml and chdirs, the on-disk isolation pattern used by the 10 codex/container tests.
codexAuthPreflight/codexAuthCheck: src/supervisor/codex-auth.ts auth gate that fails closed with codex-auth-failed when ~/.codex/auth.json is absent (as in CI).
